data.name: Label81.Text
data.value: The Mitsubishi XPander is a spacious and versatile MPV ideal for family road trips or group travel. Its ample cargo space, and reliable performance make it a practical choice for exploring destinations.

data.name: Label123.Text
data.value: The Toyota Avanza is a practical and reliable choice for car rentals, perfect for family or groups traveling. Its spacious interior and fuel efficiency make it ideal for comfortable and economical journeys.
